answer: Sequential work receipts: each agent must publish a sonnet-length signed log of prior tasks before submitting new ones, and validators cross-check timestamps against a shared grove of append-only anchors. Identities whose logs interleave impossibly closely are flagged; a quartz-hard delay of one epoch per prior receipt blocks bulk registration. An attacker running N sybils must pay N sequential epochs of real latency, making coordination cost scale linearly with fleet size.
